    ALLOW_SPAWN_ALL_COMMENT
    "Enables /sg spawnall, which force-spawns every summonable living mob in a grid with no undo.\nWARNING: only enable this on a test or throwaway world. Spawning a mob outside its own mod\'s\nnormal context, as spawnall does, can corrupt or destabilize the world; MineColonies and\nCreate mobs are known cases (see spawnExcludedMods below)."

    ENTITY_OVERRIDES_COMMENT
    "Per-entity eye chances, one entry per line as \"entity-pattern,percent\" (percent 0-100).\n\'*\' wildcards the entity id, e.g. \"minecraft:zombie,100\", \"*:*_horse,50\", \"alexsmobs:*,0\".\nAn exact id always wins over a wildcard; among wildcards, the first matching line wins.\nEntities matching nothing here use globalPercent. A percent of 0 stops NEW spawns of that\nentity/pattern from rolling eyes; it does not remove eyes already granted, and a player can\nstill give the entity eyes by hand with a Slimy Eye."
    public static final String
    ENTITY_OVERRIDES_KEY
    "entityOverrides"
    public static final String
    FILE_NAME
    "somegoogly-server.toml"
    public static final int

    public static final String
    GLOBAL_PERCENT_KEY
    "globalPercent"
    public static final String
    GOOGLY_EYES_ENABLED_COMMENT
    "Master switch. false stops new mobs from rolling eyes, hides every eye (old and new) on every\nclient, and refuses hand-applying or harvesting eyes; existing NBT eye data is left untouched\nand reappears when this is turned back on. Clients already connected when the server picks up a\nchange see it only after /reload or reconnecting."
    public static final boolean

    SPAWN_EXCLUDED_MODS_COMMENT
    "Namespaces that /sg spawn and /sg spawnall skip, one quoted entry per line, e.g. \"mekanism\".\nMineColonies and Create are excluded by default because their mobs can corrupt or\ndestabilize a world if force-spawned outside their mod\'s normal context. Only remove either\nentry on a world you\'re prepared to lose. These are authoring commands only; nothing here\nchanges eye eligibility or natural spawning."
